curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach how to start the car, feed in speed, hold and turn the wheel, keep the eyes twelve seconds ahead, when to glance aside and behind, and the separate four second sight rule for speed.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; a contrast card for the twelve second look ahead versus the four second sight rule.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on starting, steering, scanning and the sight rule.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover left and right scans before entering, left turn yields, right turns on red, dead signals and fresh greens, blind corners, blocking the box, and rail crossings.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for left turn versus right on red, dead signal versus fresh green, and waiting versus edging forward.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on intersection yields and signal trust.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the orange and black work zone boards, the lower posted limits, the penalties and doubled phone fines, and how to drive through a zone.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; a contrast card for the boards versus the penalties.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on work zone signs, limits and penalties.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain the stiffer penalties for harming vulnerable users and the three foot pass, emergency vehicles and roadside stops, crosswalk rights, white canes and guide dogs, children, and ice cream trucks.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for painted versus implied crosswalks and for ordinary walkers versus cane and guide dog users.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on walkers, children and emergency vehicles.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach bikes as vehicles, rider duties, driver yields and the three foot pass, turning and door checks, passing in no passing zones, and bike lane rules.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for bike yield fines versus ordinary yields and for no passing zones versus bike lanes.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on sharing the road with bicycles.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover motorcycle lane rights and blind spots, left turn danger, following distance and signals, slow trucks, tractors and buses, and horses.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; a contrast card for cars splitting a lane versus two motorcycles sharing one.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on motorcycles, slow vehicles and horses.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the truck No-Zones at the sides, front and rear, stopping room and cut ins, wide turns, truck limits, and how to pass a truck.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; a contrast card for the front versus rear No-Zone.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on truck No-Zones and passing trucks.
